set -eu
if ! getent group inventory-worker >/dev/null 2>&1; then groupadd -r inventory-worker; fi
if ! id inventory-worker >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd -r -g inventory-worker -d /var/lib/inventory -s /sbin/nologin inventory-worker; fi
install -d -o inventory-worker -g inventory-worker -m 0750 /var/lib/inventory
cat > /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker <<'INVENTORY_WORKER_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -u
umask 027
probe() {
    target=$1
    label=$2
    if (: > "$target") 2>/dev/null; then
        printf 'UNEXPECTED_WRITE_ALLOWED %s\n' "$label" >> /var/lib/inventory/sandbox-check.log
        rm -f "$target"
    else
        printf 'write_blocked %s\n' "$label" >> /var/lib/inventory/sandbox-check.log
    fi
}
: > /var/lib/inventory/sandbox-check.log
probe /tmp/inventory-worker-escape tmp
probe /var/tmp/inventory-worker-escape var_tmp
probe /etc/inventory-worker-escape etc
printf 'write_allowed inventory_dir\n' >> /var/lib/inventory/sandbox-check.log
while :; do
    printf '%s inventory scan complete\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
    sleep 5
done
INVENTORY_WORKER_EOF
chown root:root /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'INVENTORY_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
ExecStart=/usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
Restart=always
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
ReadOnlyDirectories=/
ReadWriteDirectories=/var/lib/inventory
InaccessibleDirectories=/tmp /var/tmp /dev/shm /run /home /root

[Install]
